reference: Beinlich I, Suermondt HJ, Chavez RM, Cooper GF (1989). "The ALARM Monitoring System: A Case Study with Two Probabilistic Inference Techniques for Belief Networks." Proceedings of the 2nd European Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Medicine, 247–256.
context: ALARM ("A Logical Alarm Reduction Mechanism") is a Bayesian network for patient monitoring alarms. It represents cardiovascular status, oxygenation/ventilation, and ventilator/tube conditions using discretized clinical measurements and device states.

variables.name: CVP
variables.description: Central venous pressure; a coarse indicator of venous pressure/volume status (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: PCWP
variables.description: Pulmonary capillary wedge pressure; a coarse indicator related to left-side filling pressure (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: HIST
variables.description: History; whether relevant patient history is present as a binary flag (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: TPR
variables.description: Total peripheral resistance; an overall resistance to blood flow in the systemic circulation (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: BP
variables.description: Blood pressure; an overall arterial pressure state (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: CO
variables.description: Cardiac output; overall blood flow pumped by the heart per unit time (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: HRBP
variables.description: Heart rate / blood pressure; a combined/derived discretized state capturing HR relative to BP (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: HREK
variables.description: Heart rate measured by an EKG monitor; observed HR reading from EKG (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: HRSA
variables.description: Heart rate / oxygen saturation; a combined/derived discretized state capturing HR relative to SAO2 (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: PAP
variables.description: Pulmonary artery pressure; pressure in the pulmonary artery circulation (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: SAO2
variables.description: Arterial oxygen saturation; overall oxygen saturation level in arterial blood (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: FIO2
variables.description: Fraction of inspired oxygen; the delivered oxygen fraction from the breathing mixture (levels: LOW, NORMAL).

variables.name: PRSS
variables.description: Breathing pressure; an observed pressure level in the breathing circuit/airway (levels: ZERO, LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: ECO2
variables.description: Expelled CO2; exhaled CO2 level in expired gas (levels: ZERO, LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: MINV
variables.description: Minimum volume; an observed ventilation volume level (levels: ZERO, LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: MVS
variables.description: Minimum volume set; the set/target minimum ventilation volume (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: HYP
variables.description: Hypovolemia; whether low circulating blood volume is present (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: LVF
variables.description: Left ventricular failure; whether LV failure is present (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: APL
variables.description: Anaphylaxis; whether an anaphylactic event/state is present (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: ANES
variables.description: Insufficient anesthesia/analgesia; whether anesthesia/analgesia is insufficient (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: PMB
variables.description: Pulmonary embolus; whether a pulmonary embolus is present (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: INT
variables.description: Intubation; tube placement status (levels: NORMAL, ESOPHAGEAL, ONESIDED).

variables.name: KINK
variables.description: Kinked tube; whether the breathing tube is kinked/obstructed (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: DISC
variables.description: Disconnection; whether a disconnection in the breathing circuit has occurred (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: LVV
variables.description: Left ventricular end-diastolic volume; a coarse LV filling/volume state (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: STKV
variables.description: Stroke volume; blood volume ejected per heartbeat (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: CCHL
variables.description: Catecholamine; overall catecholamine level/state (levels: NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: ERLO
variables.description: Error low output; a binary flag indicating a low-output error/state (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: HR
variables.description: Heart rate; overall HR state (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: ERCA
variables.description: Electrocauter; whether electrocautery is being used (often relevant to monitoring conditions) (levels: TRUE, FALSE).

variables.name: SHNT
variables.description: Shunt; a coarse shunt state (levels: NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: PVS
variables.description: Pulmonary venous oxygen saturation; oxygen saturation state on the pulmonary venous side (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: ACO2
variables.description: Arterial CO2; overall arterial CO2 level state (levels: LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: VALV
variables.description: Pulmonary alveoli ventilation; ventilation level at the alveolar level (levels: ZERO, LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: VLNG
variables.description: Lung ventilation; overall lung ventilation level (levels: ZERO, LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: VTUB
variables.description: Ventilation tube; ventilation level through/at the tube (levels: ZERO, LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).

variables.name: VMCH
variables.description: Ventilation machine; ventilation level/output attributed to the ventilator machine (levels: ZERO, LOW, NORMAL, HIGH).
